select.description:
The type of reactive parameter. One of:
- `"value"` (default) for a standard `Param`
- `"intersect"` for a `Selection` that intersects clauses (logical "and")
- `"union"` for a `Selection` that unions clauses (logical "or")
- `"single"` for a `Selection` that retains a single clause only
- `"crossfilter"` for a cross-filtered intersection `Selection`

date.description: The initial parameter value as an ISO date/time string to be parsed to a Date object.

- `"crossfilter"` for a cross-filtered intersection `Selection`

cross.description: A flag for cross-filtering, where selections made in a plot filter others but not oneself (default `false`, except for `crossfilter` selections).

empty.description: A flag for setting an initial empty selection state. If true, a selection with no clauses corresponds to an empty selection with no records. If false, a selection with no clauses selects all values.

include.description: Upstream selections whose clauses should be included as part of this selection. Any clauses or activations published to the upstream selections will be relayed to this selection.
